title: Plateau, distillation, noisy judge, matched-budget per state (Nov 13–20)
question: Where do AG rounds and DSRL level off on moka, can the gain be distilled into π₀.₅, and how do the methods handle a noisy judge?
verdict: Both level off at 85–90%: AG r5 87.6%, DSRL seed 1 87.0–90.0% from 1,300 to 3,300 episodes.
Distilling DSRL or AG successes into π₀.₅ keeps the teacher's success (88.2% / 89.1%); distilling base's successes gives 49.7%.
25% symmetric label flips: AG +0.6, DSRL −36.7 to −47.9 points.
Guidance push 0.8–1.2 is flat; reference changes and IQL labels did not help; dropping demos helped (+27.9 at 50 rollouts).
At matched budget no start state is solved by one method and unsolved by the other.
